{"consolidated_memory":"**Latency Spikes in ml/serving/batcher.py — Two Separate Incidents**

Both incidents occurred in the same file (ml/serving/batcher.py) in the ml pipeline, both manifested as latency spikes visible in the serving histogram tail, and both were resolved with context from prior related work in this code corner.

**INCIDENT 1: [2026-01-11] Floating-Point Rounding in Money Path**
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Signal: tail far above median in serving histogram
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #1499, branch fix/latency-spike-1
- Repro method: send mixed-size request trace
- Measured outcome: nightly rollup matched source counts for 46 days running

**INCIDENT 2: [2026-04-01] Off-by-One in Slice Bound**
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Signal: tail far above median in serving histogram
- Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #6033, branch fix/latency-spike-2
- Repro method: send mixed-size request trace
- Measured outcome: reclaimed 34 GB of blob storage"}
